headline: Oil Prices Rise Following Reports of US Strikes on Iran
summary: Crude oil prices rose following a report of a U.S. strike on Iran’s Qeshm Island. Brent crude traded at $105.26 per barrel and West Texas Intermediate traded at $97.07 per barrel.
why: Crude oil benchmarks are primary global energy market indicators, and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East frequently disrupt supply expectations and drive price volatility.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical conflict in the Middle East directly increases energy supply risk premiums, lifting crude prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reports of military strikes involving Iran directly raise concerns over Middle Eastern oil supply disruptions, driving an immediate increase in crude prices.
